about:
Diversified Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1976 by Rod Reid in his garage in Missoula, Montana, initially supplying engineered plastic wear strips to lumber and pulp mills in the surrounding area. The family-owned business is now led by Reid's son, Brad Reid, a mechanical engineer, alongside a team of manufacturing professionals.

The company operates as a custom plastics fabrication and engineering firm, offering injection molding of UHMW-PE and other resins, cast urethane, CNC machining, thermoforming, and custom fabrication under one roof. Its MultiFab approach combines these processes to produce hybrid components. By the end of 2025, the 3.5-acre campus will encompass over 60,000 square feet of building space with four 80,000-pound silos. The shop runs injection molding machines with shot capacities from 19 to 311 ounces and delivers tens of thousands of parts annually.

Diversified Plastics serves industries including industrial wastewater treatment, mining, forest products, grain handling, car wash equipment, oil and gas, and food and beverage. Customers range from international wastewater treatment leaders to local Montana breweries. The company ships to more than 15 countries and supports OEM replacement parts, maintenance, and new product development.

The firm differentiates itself through its proprietary injection molding of UHMW virgin and regrind materials, in-house tool design and mold fabrication, and Lean Production protocols. It emphasizes a problem-solving partnership model, aiming to convert machined metal parts to cost-effective molded plastics while reducing material waste through in-house recycling of nearly 250,000 pounds of scrap per year.
